_comment: Refs the retention sweep must NEVER delete, beyond what images.json and the keep-last-N rule already protect. Two sources: (1) hal0 code pins — this list is the LOCAL FLOOR; retention.py additionally fetches hal0's machine-readable export (exports/runner-image-pins.json on Hal0ai/hal0 main, generated from src/hal0/config/schema.py) at run start and UNIONS it with this list, aborting the whole run on any fetch/parse failure. Keep this local floor populated anyway (defense in depth); (2) issue-evidence refs kept for open investigations.
_comment_hal0_code_pins: Mirrors hal0 src/hal0/config/schema.py (DEFAULT_ROCMFPX_IMAGE, DEFAULT_STRIX_IMAGE, DEFAULT_PROMPTFORGE_IMAGE) plus the manifest.json toolbox_images.{strix,promptforge} digests those tags are pinned at. Tag AND digest form, so a re-pushed tag cannot orphan the consumed digest. The rocm-7.2.4-rocmfp4-server base digest every runners/* recipe FROMs lives in ghcr.io/hal0ai/amd-strix-halo-toolboxes, which the sweep never touches (it lists hal0-* packages only); that package must never be deleted (docs/CONSOLIDATION.md).
